ACTION: Create /tmp/validate_ridership/profile.py, a read-only profiler for the two parquets (nothing in `ridership/` or `data/` is modified):
```python
import sys
import polars as pl

for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    lf = pl.scan_parquet(p)
    print("==", p)
    print(lf.collect_schema())
    print(lf.select(
        pl.len().alias("rows"),
        pl.col("started_at").min().alias("min_started"),
        pl.col("started_at").max().alias("max_started"),
        pl.col("trip_id").null_count().alias("null_trip_id"),
        pl.col("trip_id").n_unique().alias("uniq_trip_id"),
    ).collect())
    # raw vs deduped per district, including any district names the filter silently drops
    print(lf.group_by("district").agg(
        pl.len().alias("raw"), pl.col("trip_id").n_unique().alias("uniq_trip_id")
    ).sort("district").collect())
    # are the duplicate trip_ids fully identical rows, or distinct trips sharing an id?
    print("fully-unique rows:", lf.unique().select(pl.len()).collect().item())
    # daily counts at both edges of the quarter
    daily = lf.group_by(pl.col("started_at").dt.date().alias("d")).agg(pl.len().alias("n")).sort("d").collect()
    print(daily.head(5)); print(daily.tail(5))
```
